svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: TIG weld the bars to the spine foot first (AC, ER5356), in a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: jig that holds their trunk-side faces at 120 deg, bottoms

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: level. 5 mm fillets all round each bar end; the bar ends must not

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stand proud of the spine's front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Then the four eye rings, then the two cheeks.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the V faces meet (if extended) 8 in front of the spine

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front edge; both bar faces flat within 1 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clean the bar faces, slots and eyes with a stainless brush;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: run a 7 mm bar through both slots and the 8 pin through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its hole. Inspect every weld; no repair welding of a crack.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stamp SWL 100 kg ONE PERSON and the frame number on the spine.
